simple.meaning: מִשְׁקֶלֶת (mishqeleth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a weight , i.e. a plummet (with line attached).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.short: a weight , i.e. a plummet (with line attached)
definitions.full: H4949. mishqeleth or mishqoleth [ מִשְׁקֶ֫לֶת ], מִשְׁקֹ֫לֶת noun feminine levelling instrument, level (for horizontal accuracy); — absolute מִשְׁקָ֑לֶת Isa 28:17 (figurative of צֶדָקָה ;|| קַו ); construct קֹ֫לֶת -, figurative, ׳מ אַחְאָב בֵּית 2Kin 21:13 .

occurrences.englishText: I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipes a dish, wiping it and turning it upside down.
I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
